cohort: The study included 676 postpartum women admitted to the postpartum wards of Mobini maternity hospital in Iran.
finding: Emergency caesarean, instrumental birth, episiotomy, Entonox analgesia, low well-being, fear of COVID-19, low satisfaction with pregnancy, and low satisfaction with spouse's support were identified as predictors of low birth satisfaction.
mod_finding: Emergency caesarean and instrumental birth were identified as predictors of low birth satisfaction.
